title: AI Zero Network Receipt v0.1
description: Schema for Receipts in AI Zero Network v0.1. A Receipt records a successfully completed externally effective action performed under validated authority.

trace_id.description: Identifier of the Trace associated with the externally effective action.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the participant that performed the action.

action.description: Short identifier or description of the externally effective action that actually occurred.

authority_used.description: Authority scopes actually used to perform the action.

resources.description: Optional resources consumed by the action.

tokens.description: Number of model tokens consumed, if measured.

result_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of the resulting externally observable output or state representation.

prev_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 digest linking this Receipt to a preceding Receipt, or null when no predecessor exists.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature, attestation, or equivalent integrity proof.

timestamp.description: Time at which the externally effective action successfully completed.
